title: Certifying Emphysema Densitometry from Thick-Slice CT by Residual Arbitration
hook: On real 5 mm chest CT, essentially all of the emphysema-index accuracy that restoration networks gain from real-paired fine-tuning is carried by a single global attenuation offset — and that offset is detectable from the thick series alone, because slab averaging preserves slab means for every slice-profile width. A restoration pipeline that identifies its own acquisition operator per scan can therefore decompose its data-consistency residual into a displacement term and a structural term, and refuse to report a densitometric value whose accuracy came from the displacement term.
hook_shape_rationale: (i) Shape (a) surprising empirical reveal: the named metric is the displacement term delta_hat of the data-consistency residual, and the non-obvious prediction is its DIRECTION of association — models whose LAA-950 error improves after real-pair fine-tuning show a LARGE |delta_hat| with an unchanged structural residual and an unchanged lung-attenuation variance, i.e. the accuracy gain is anti-correlated with the evidence of genuine tail recovery; a reader fluent in openalex:W4404646478 and dblp:journals/corr/abs-2206-06253 expects the opposite, since both treat fine-tuning on real pairs as the fix. (ii) Shape (b) was viable — the tacit assumption 'the through-plane operator is given' is operationalised in every restoration leg — but (b) is the cheapest shape and the assumption is only interesting BECAUSE of the empirical reveal, so it is folded into the sibling audit leg instead of being the headline.

gap_closure.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf can establish WHY its reconstruction's threshold statistic is correct — i.e. none separates 'the low-attenuation tail of the lung histogram was recovered' from 'the histogram was displaced until the threshold count matched', and none reports a quantity that would distinguish them on a scan whose reference is unavailable — stakes: this is exactly the failure we measured on real scanner output, where the entire apparent gain of real-pair fine-tuning was reproduced by a single -12.2 HU output-bias change while the reconstructed histogram stayed too narrow (54.9 vs 58.6 HU); a centre that adopts such a model gets an emphysema index that is right on the validation cohort and drifts arbitrarily on the next scanner, and intellectually every published thick-slice-restoration densitometry result is uninterpretable because the two explanations were never separated.
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by making the boundary between the learned and the physical part carry a typed, machine-checkable artifact — a per-scan certificate (delta_hat, rho_struct, s) produced by a physics solver rather than by the network — and by recasting 'is this threshold statistic supported by the measurement' as a feasibility test against two constraint sets the observation itself defines, so the arbitration has a verdict instead of a tie-break.

gap_closure.gap: No retrieved leaf tests whether the through-plane acquisition operator has to be treated as KNOWN (or as one globally learned mapping) at all — every restoration leaf inherits that assumption from the shared interpolation/deconvolution ancestor, and the model-based leaves that do relax it (arxiv:2503.21501v1, arxiv:2403.04847v2, semanticscholar:0d3795c98a2a83d53704e5965e08461bc452dfc1) recover physical parameters for their own sake, without asking what a per-scan estimate would have to be accountable to — stakes: practitioners inherit a model whose degradation assumption is unfalsifiable at inference time, so a scanner whose true slice profile or noise texture sits outside the training distribution fails silently rather than loudly; intellectually, the field cannot report an operator estimate as evidence, which is why the same restoration paper can be published for 5 mm and re-published for 8 mm with no cumulative knowledge about the operator itself.
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by pivoting the assumption that identifies the acquisition: instead of assuming a known slice profile (phantom-measured or nominal), the mechanism trades that distributional/metadata assumption for a STRUCTURAL one already present in the data — slab averaging preserves slab means for any profile width, so the mean direction of the residual identifies a displacement independently of the profile, and the width is identified from the variance direction; the companion ships the confound-isolating separation, a simulated arm with a KNOWN operator versus the real arm with the same anatomy, which is the only way to show the pivot changes the endpoint rather than only the image.

gap_closure.gap: No retrieved leaf produces, per scan and without a reference, an adjudicated verdict about its own output — the model-based line ends at a residual norm, the agentic line (arxiv:2605.22208v2, arxiv:2606.29763v1) ends at a plan, and neither converts a disagreement between the physics it assumed and the observation it was given into an actionable statement about the number a clinician will read — stakes: in a multi-centre trial the practical question is not 'is the image nicer' but 'may I pool this scan's emphysema index with the others', and today that question is answered by protocol paperwork rather than by the reconstruction; without it, restoration cannot enter a densitometry endpoint pipeline at all, whatever its PSNR.
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by treating the arbiter's certificate as the manufactured label-free signal: delta_hat and rho_struct are internal readouts computable at inference with no thin-slice reference, they localise the failure to a named site (displacement versus structural mismatch versus operator mismatch), and the same readout is used twice — as the training penalty on the displacement direction the current objective otherwise exploits for free, and as the deployment gate that emits certify / flag / abstain for the scan's densitometric value.

core_mechanism: The pipeline is decomposed at two responsibility boundaries into three solvers that exchange typed artifacts rather than activations. (1) OPERATOR SOLVER (sound, non-learned): given the observed thick volume y (HU, D_t x H x W, from the archived series) and the current thin estimate x_tilde (initialised as the trilinear up-sampling of y onto the 1 mm grid), it fits the through-plane acquisition A_w — a z-Gaussian of full-width-half-maximum w followed by a strided average over r = thick spacing / thin spacing — by grid search w_hat = argmin_w ||A_w(x_tilde) - y||_2 over W = {2.00, 2.25, ..., 12.00} mm (grid step delta_w = 0.25 mm), and estimates the through-plane noise sigma_hat as the robust standard deviation of first differences along z inside the lung mask divided by sqrt(2). Its typed output is (w_hat, sigma_hat, rho) with rho = ||A_{w_hat}(x_hat) - y||_2 / ||y - mean(y)||_2, the fraction of the thick slab's own variation that the fitted physical model cannot explain. (2) RECONSTRUCTION SOLVER (learned): the 3D residual network is FiLM-conditioned on (w_hat, sigma_hat) instead of a nominal width, and returns x_hat on the 1 mm grid. (3) DENSITOMETRY SOLVER (sound, non-learned): it never looks at the image as an image — it reads only lung-masked moments, and computes what the observation ADMITS. The lung set is L = {v : hu_air_floor < v < hu_lung_ceiling} with hu_air_floor = -990 HU (excluding clipped air: outside-body and large-airway lumen) and hu_lung_ceiling = -500 HU (the conventional parenchyma window), evaluated on the thick grid. The displacement constraint C_mean uses the ERODED INTERIOR of that set, L_e = erode(L, e_mask), with erosion radius e_mask = 8 voxels in-plane and ceil(3*sigma(w_max)/r) slices along z (default 8; swept 4-12): because the Gaussian kernel is normalised and the pooling is an average, A_w preserves the mean of every slab for EVERY w, but that identity holds only where the averaged support lies inside the set — on an un-eroded intensity mask, blurring exchanges voxels across the lung/soft-tissue boundary and the exchanged mass grows with w, which we measured on a real pair as a +6.9 HU offset for a PERFECT reconstruction and a 9.4 HU swing across w in [4,10] mm, versus -0.55 HU and a 0.04 HU swing on the eroded interior. The displacement estimate is therefore delta_hat = mean_{L_e}(R), in HU, where R = A_{w_hat}(x_hat) - y; when L_e is empty (a crop with too little parenchyma) the arbiter returns ABSTAIN rather than a verdict. C_var: for a locally stationary texture the operator attenuates through-plane variance by a factor kappa(w, r) computable in closed form from the discrete kernel (kappa = ||k_w * pool_r||_2^2 with k_w the normalised sampled Gaussian), so the thin-slice variance the observation implies is v_hat = Var_lung(y) / kappa(w_hat, r) and the reconstruction's variance deficit is s = 1 - Var_lung(x_hat) / v_hat. The certificate is the triple c = (delta_hat, rho_struct, s) where rho_struct = ||R - delta_hat||_2 / ||y - mean(y)||_2 is the residual AFTER the displacement direction has been removed. The arbiter is then a feasibility verdict, not a score: the scan is CERTIFIED when |delta_hat| <= tau_delta (default 2 HU, swept 1-5 HU), rho_struct <= tau_rho (default 0.15, swept 0.10-0.25) and |s| <= tau_s (default 0.15, swept 0.10-0.25); otherwise it is FLAGGED and the dominant violated term is named, which is what turns 'the physics and the network disagree' into 'this scan's LAA-950 may not be pooled, because the value is carried by a displacement of magnitude delta_hat'. The three gaps share this machinery rather than needing separate modules: the audit leg is what makes the certificate meaningful (computed under a per-scan w_hat rather than a nominal 5 mm, since a wrong width inflates rho and hides delta_hat inside it), and the verdict leg is the same certificate read at inference where no reference exists. Only one term feeds training: L = L_voxel + w_dc L_dc + w_traj L_traj + w_nps L_nps + lambda_delta |delta_hat| with lambda_delta = 1.0 (swept 0.1-10), which closes the free lunch the current objective exploits — the trajectory guardrail can otherwise buy LAA accuracy with a global shift that L_dc, computed under a nominal operator, is too weak to bill.
core_mechanism_reasoning: BLOCK 1 - PREMISES. (P1) The through-plane acquisition of a thick series is, to first order, a normalised slab average along z: believed because that is how helical reconstruction forms a thick slice from the same raw data, and because on RPLHR-CT real 1 mm/5 mm pairs a fitted Gaussian-plus-average model reproduces the real thick series with a median unexplained residual of 12.8% of its standard deviation. (P2) The fitted width is stable within a protocol and lies inside the family the model was trained over: measured across 50 real pairs the fitted effective width was 6.25 mm (range 5.75-6.75) for a nominally 5 mm series. (P3) LAA-950 and Perc15 are functionals of the lung-voxel attenuation histogram, so a global displacement and a tail recovery are different objects with different observable signatures — this is what the certificate exploits. (P4, OBSERVATION-MODEL premise) The mechanism's inputs are the archived thick series and a lung mask; the fit is unbiased only over voxels where the slab-average model holds, so the mask must exclude clipped air (<= -990 HU, outside body and large airway lumen) and the crop must lie inside the lung bounding box, otherwise mean_lung(R) is dominated by boundary voxels where replicate padding breaks the mean-preservation identity — untested at scale, falsification target. (P5) The variance factor kappa is computed for a locally stationary texture; parenchyma is approximately stationary within a patch but vessels are not — untested, falsification target, and the reason s is a certificate term and not a training loss. ESTIMAND: delta_hat estimates the constant additive offset between the reconstruction's lung attenuation distribution and the distribution consistent with the observed slab means, defined over lung voxels of the analysed volume; rho_struct estimates the fraction of the observed thick-slab variation unexplained by the identified operator after removing that offset; s estimates the relative deficit of the reconstruction's through-plane lung variance against the variance the observation implies. BLOCK 2 - NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT. The naive version: keep the single restoration network, add a data-consistency loss ||A_5mm(x_hat) - y||^2 with the nominal 5 mm operator, and report its residual as evidence. It does not work because it silently relies on the premise that the assumed operator is the true one, which is FALSE here (nominal 5.00 mm versus fitted 6.25 mm; 12.8% of the thick signal unexplained), so the residual conflates operator error with reconstruction error and a 12 HU displacement hides inside it — which is exactly what we observed: a model fine-tuned on real pairs improved LAA-950 while moving only its output bias, and no term in the objective billed it. The mechanism must therefore confront that conflation head-on, and the confrontation IS the contribution: identify the operator per scan, then decompose the residual along the direction that moves a threshold count (the mean direction) versus the rest. STANDARD-TOOL FOLLOW-UP: the decomposition is, in isolation, a textbook projection / generalised-least-squares move. The domain-specific structure that keeps this instance unsolved is (i) the quantity of record is a THRESHOLD FUNCTIONAL of the histogram, so the relevant directions are the ones that move a count across -950 HU (the constant direction and the variance direction), not the L2-dominant ones; and (ii) the operator width and the displacement are a priori confusable — both shrink apparent lung heterogeneity — and it is the mean-preservation property of slab averaging that separates them, which is a property of THIS acquisition model rather than of least squares. BLOCK 3 - DESIGN RATIONALE. The three gaps share one machinery because the same residual object serves all of them: identified under the audit leg's per-scan operator, decomposed by the anchor's feasibility reframe, and read without a reference by the verdict leg — building three modules would have duplicated the residual three times with three different operators. We considered two alternatives. (a) Constrain the reconstruction to be mean-consistent by construction (project x_hat so that A(x_hat) matches y exactly): rejected because it hard-codes the fitted operator into the output, so the certificate would become vacuous by construction and the failure would move to the width estimate unobserved. (b) Add the variance deficit s as a training loss: rejected because the model can satisfy it by injecting through-plane noise, which restores variance without restoring structure and would re-create the very ambiguity the certificate exists to detect; s therefore stays a report-only term. REGRESSION AVOIDED (method_lineage): the mechanism must not land on n1 (deconvolve with a nominal phantom-measured SSP), on n13/n15 (harmonise to a reference kernel or protocol), on n16 (phantom SSP measurement), or on n12 (a reasoning agent that selects restoration tools) — here the operator is identified from the patient series itself, no reference protocol is required, and the solvers own physical estimands under a data-consistency contract rather than choosing tools.
core_mechanism_steps: 1. Data: build real thin/thick pairs from RPLHR-CT (public, CC-BY-4.0, 250 chest CT with real 1 mm and 5 mm reconstructions) with the existing prep path — lung bounding box, z-alignment by grid search over +-4 thick slices, trim so D_thin = r * D_thick — and a simulated arm from the same thin volumes via A_w with a KNOWN w, giving two arms with identical anatomy and a controlled operator axis. Inputs: NIfTI volumes; outputs: aligned .npy pairs plus a per-case audit row (offset, match error, lung fraction). 2. Implement the operator solver as a module that takes (y, x_tilde, r) and returns (w_hat, sigma_hat, rho): grid search over W with delta_w = 0.25 mm, each evaluation one blur-plus-pool forward pass; cache the per-case profile ||A_w(x_tilde) - y||_2 over the whole grid so the fit's sharpness is inspectable, and record whether the argmin sits at a grid endpoint (a boundary-saturated fit is reported, not silently accepted). Outputs feed both the FiLM conditioning and the certificate. 3. Replace the network's nominal-width conditioning: pass (w_hat, sigma_hat) as the M1 conditioning vector instead of the constant fwhm_to_sigma(5.0), so the reconstruction it emits is the one implied by the identified operator; this changes the produced volume x_hat, hence every downstream statistic read off it. 4. Implement the densitometry solver: build the thick-grid lung set L with the named window (hu_air_floor, hu_lung_ceiling), erode it by e_mask to get L_e, and compute delta_hat = mean_{L_e}(A_{w_hat}(x_hat) - y), rho_struct after removing delta_hat, kappa(w_hat, r) in closed form from the sampled kernel, v_hat = Var_lung(y)/kappa, and s = 1 - Var_lung(x_hat)/v_hat; if |L_e| = 0 emit ABSTAIN. Output: the typed certificate record (w_hat, sigma_hat, rho, delta_hat, rho_struct, s, verdict) written per case to CSV alongside LAA-950 and Perc15. 4b. Estimator validation before any model is trained: run step 4 with x_hat set to the TRUE thin volume on the held-out real pairs — a perfect reconstruction must yield delta_hat within the reported floor and s within tau_s; any term that fails this test is reported as an estimator bias, not as a model property. 5. Add lambda_delta |delta_hat| to the training loss and re-train; delta_hat is differentiable through A_{w_hat} and the network, so the gradient acts on the reconstruction's lung mean and directly changes the LAA-950 count it produces. 6. Arbiter: implement certify/flag/abstain as a pure function of the certificate and the thresholds (tau_delta, tau_rho, tau_s), emitting the verdict, the dominant violated term, and the densitometric value it gates. 7. Evaluation harness: for every model in the comparison — trilinear baseline, the existing restoration model, the same model fine-tuned on real pairs, an output-bias-only recalibration of it, and ours — compute on the held-out REAL pairs the endpoint metrics (LAA-950 MAE and CCC, Perc15 MAE) TOGETHER with the certificate, and report them jointly; a model may not report an endpoint without its certificate. 8. Ablations, each a separate training or evaluation run: (a) freeze w_hat at the nominal 5.00 mm (operator solver removed) and recompute everything; (b) set lambda_delta = 0 (displacement penalty removed); (c) remove the FiLM conditioning on (w_hat, sigma_hat) while keeping the certificate, isolating identification-for-conditioning from identification-for-auditing; (d) sweep e_mask over 4-12 voxels to show the displacement term's stability is a property of the estimator and not of one radius. 9. Cross-thickness check: repeat the whole pipeline at r = 8 (8 mm thick series) using the same code path, and verify the operator solver recovers a wider w_hat without retuning any threshold. 10. Report the certificate distribution per arm: simulated (operator known) versus real (operator identified), which is the confound-isolating separation the audit leg owes.
falsification_prediction: Minimal experiment: on the RPLHR-CT real-paired chest CT benchmark, hold out the official validation split as a test set, train the restoration model in three arms — simulated-thick supervision only, real-pair fine-tuned, and ours (per-scan identified operator plus the displacement penalty) — and evaluate each on the SAME held-out real pairs, reporting LAA-950 MAE and concordance with the 1 mm reference, Perc15 MAE, and the certificate (delta_hat, rho_struct, s) per case. If the candidate works, LAA-950 concordance on the real arm rises relative to the simulated-supervision arm WHILE |delta_hat| stays small and the variance deficit s shrinks, whereas the real-pair fine-tuned arm reaches comparable concordance with a large |delta_hat| and an unchanged s — i.e. the two arms are separated by the certificate even though the endpoint metric alone does not distinguish them. The load-bearing variable is delta_hat, the lung-masked mean of the data-consistency residual. Negative control: ablate its producer by freezing the operator solver at the nominal width (w_hat := 5.00 mm) so delta_hat is computed under a mis-specified operator; the prediction is on the DOWNSTREAM outcome — LAA-950 concordance with the reference on the real arm falls back toward the un-fine-tuned regime and the certificate stops separating the arms, because the displacement term is then absorbed into rho. A second control randomises delta_hat's sign per batch during training (breaking the penalty while keeping its magnitude in the loss), which should remove the endpoint gain if the mechanism acts through the displacement direction rather than through extra regularisation. Positive control: a stripped-down arm that keeps the ORIGINAL network and only recalibrates its output bias by -delta_hat measured on a handful of real pairs — if that arm already matches the fine-tuned arm's endpoint metrics, the displacement explanation is confirmed as the operative mechanism of current real-pair fine-tuning, which is the reveal the hook claims.
compute_budget: ≈2 GPU-days total on a single 16 GB consumer GPU (RTX 5080): one training run of the 0.35 M-parameter 3D model is 20-40 min, and the campaign is ~40 runs (3 arms x 3 ablations x 3 seeds, plus the r = 8 repeat and threshold sweeps); the operator grid search adds ~40 blur-plus-pool forward passes per case, which is seconds. Data preparation (2 x 150 volumes through the pairing path) is ~1 CPU-hour x 4 processes. No paid API is used. Against the default envelope (80 GB-class GPUs, ~150 GPU-days) this is comfortable, and it is deliberately sized to run on hardware a hospital research group already owns.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: They construct a thick-to-thin mapping and validate that the restored volume changes reader and downstream-AI diagnostic outcomes; we construct, per scan and without a reference, a decomposition of the observation residual into an operator term, a displacement term and a structural term, and gate the densitometric readout on it — a quantity their pipeline never produces and could not produce, since its degradation model is fixed.

They establish that models trained on simulated degradation transfer poorly to real thick series and measure that gap in PSNR/SSIM; we attribute the gap to a specific, separately-measurable pair of quantities (a fitted effective width that differs from the nominal one, and a mean-direction displacement of the reconstruction) and show the endpoint consequence on emphysema densitometry rather than on image similarity.

They infer image and measurement operator jointly under one generative objective, so operator error and prior error remain entangled in a single posterior; we deliberately keep the estimands in separate solvers and project the resulting residual onto the direction that moves a threshold functional, which is what makes the attribution — and therefore the refusal to report — possible.

They absorb forward-model mismatch into an untrained per-instance correction network, leaving the mismatch unnamed; we identify it as two reportable physical quantities (effective slice width, unexplained residual fraction) and use them as an inference-time gate rather than as capacity.

They harmonise reconstruction kernels to a reference setting so that emphysema extent correlates better with clinical parameters, which requires the reference protocol to exist; we estimate the acquisition per scan from the series itself and never require a reference protocol, and we address slice thickness, which kernel conversion leaves untouched.

They bound how much, where and how stably a restoration may edit its input in the image domain; we bound and report the induced error of the FUNCTIONAL that is actually read (a threshold count on the attenuation histogram), which an image-domain bound neither implies nor detects, since a small diffuse offset is admissible under their bound and decisive for ours.

Their agents select restoration tools and their order from experience, with the intermediate artifact being a plan; our solvers own physical estimands and the intermediate artifact is a machine-checkable certificate whose violation has a defined consequence for the reported measurement.

They regress volume, noise and inter-scanner bias out of a lung-density summary after the fact; we produce the volume itself together with evidence about whether its histogram is supported by the measurement, so the correction is auditable per scan rather than fitted across a cohort.

what_step_was_missed: They construct a generative prior over measurement operators and infer the operator jointly with the image, but they never construct the projection of the resulting data-consistency residual onto the sub-space that moves a downstream functional — here, the mean direction, which slab averaging leaves invariant for every operator width and which therefore identifies a global attenuation displacement independently of the operator estimate. Without that construction the joint posterior can trade an operator error against an image offset with no observable signature, so nothing in their formulation can state whether a threshold statistic computed on the recovered image is supported by the measurement.
signature_terms: certified emphysema index thick slice CT
